name: signal_firpmord
comment: MATLAB Signal Toolbox firpmord (Phase 4.7) — Parks-McClellan FIR order estimator. remlpord formula from Rabiner & Gold pp.156-7: D = [1 d1 d1²] · AA · [1; d2; d2²] (3×3 const matrix from McClellan), fK = 11.01217 + 0.51244·(d1-d2), L = D/df - fK·df + 1. Bit-equal MATLAB R2025b on 8 fingerprints — lowpass (n=21 fo=[0,0.375,0.5,1] ao=[1,1,0,0] w=[10,1]), highpass (n=32), bandpass (n=24). Returns 4-tuple (N, ff, aa, wts) suitable for firpm. Octave 11.1.0 ships in core.
